risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial quantified information, including a $58.4 million revenue decline, a $209.9 million goodwill impairment, debt obligations, and covenant requirements. Risk tone is moderately negative due to broad-based revenue contraction, client volume reductions, loss of agency work, and reliance on discretionary marketing budgets, although management describes cost reductions and covenant compliance. Boilerplate safe-harbor language and repeated descriptions of customary credit-facility provisions somewhat dilute the risk presentation.
